title: 790. Number of Matching Subsequences

examples.explanation: The first two candidates trace through s.
All length-3 deletions work; the longer word fails.

hints: Precompute for each position in s the next occurrence of every letter so each word scans in O(word length).
Alternatively bucket words by their current needed character and stream once through s.
A plain two-pointer check per word is also fast enough for the given limits.
